μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’) · also μὴ μέν + aor. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μὴ μὲν … χεῖρ’ ἐπένεικα ’that I never laid a hand’) · also μή ποτε + fut. inf., the content of an oath: ’that … never’ (μή ποτ’ … ἀλεξήσειν ’that never will I ward off’) · μηδέ (written μὴ δ’) — and not, not even; continuing a negative (μὴ δ’ ὁπότ’ ἂν ’not even when’)
μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
νεκρὸν: νεκρός — dead man, corpse; masc. acc. sg.
νοέω: νοέω — perceive, think, form a judgment; pres. 1 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic νοῶ): ’I think’
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
νῶϊ: ἐγώ — I; pron., 1st pers. dual nom., epic νῶϊ (= Attic νώ): ’we two’ · also dual acc.: ’us two’
νῶϊν: ἐγώ — I; dual gen./dat., epic (= Attic νῷν): ’for us two’
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her, to himself’ · also masc. nom. pl. demonstrative, printed with this accent (= οἳ): ’they’ (οἷ δ’ ἐγρηγόρθασι)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: ’his own’; masc. acc. pl. (οὓς παῖδας ’his own sons’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔθ: οὔτε (elided οὔθ’, before a rough breathing) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
πάθοι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a fear clause after μή in past sequence: ’lest he suffer’
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also with a future, ’first, before that’ (πάρος … καθέξει ’first … will hold’)
πένθεϊ: πένθος — grief, mourning; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic πένθει)
πέρ: περ — at least, even; enclitic restrictive/intensive particle, accented before the enclitic μοι: τιμήν πέρ ’honour at least’ · also intensive after a relative adj., accented before the enclitic τε: οἷός πέρ τε ’just such as’ · also intensive after a relative pronoun, accented before the enclitic φασι: ’whom indeed’ · also intensive after ὅτε, accented before τε: ’just when’ · also intensive after εἰ, accented before the enclitic τε: ’if indeed’ (εἴ πέρ τε νοήσῃ ’if a man indeed notices’) · also intensive after εἰ, accented before the enclitic τι: ’if only’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει) · also intensive after a pronoun, accented before the enclitic τις: τῶν πέρ τις ’of which anyone indeed’ · also intensive after a personal pronoun, accented before the enclitic μιν: ’ourselves’ (ἡμεῖς πέρ μιν)
πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its relative pronoun: ’around’ (ἣν πέρι ’around which’) · also adv. of degree, with no genitive: ’exceedingly’ (πέρι … ἔρυτο ’guarded exceedingly’) · also prep. + acc. with anastrophe, after its noun: ’around’ (πόλιν πέρι ’around the city’)
πέτετ: πέτομαι — fly, speed; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., elided and unaugmented (πέτετ’ = ἐπέτετο): ’flew, sped’
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.
παῖδας: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’) · also + gen. with λείπομαι: ’left over from’ (πολέμοιο περὶ … λίπωνται ’are left over from the war’)
πεσόντα: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having fallen’
πεφυγμένον: φεύγω — flee, escape; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. sg., with ἔμμεναι: ’has escaped’
πηλέος: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -έως)
πηλεΐωνα: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
πιστά: πιστός — trusty, faithful; neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’faithful (oaths)’
ποδώκεα: ποδώκης — swift-footed (πούς + ὠκύς); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic -η)
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολεμιστήν: πολεμιστής — warrior, fighter; masc. acc. sg.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποσίν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., dat. of means or respect: ’with the feet’
ποσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’) · also adv., ’besides’, hardly to be translated (ποτὶ βρόμος ’the roar besides’)
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’ · also πρίν … ὅτε, ’until the time when’ · also πρίν γε … ἠέ after a negative, ’until’
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πριάμου: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg.
προΐει: προΐημι — send forth, send off; impf. 3 sg. (προΐει, diaeresis marking the separate syllable)
προπάροιθεν: προπάροιθεν — before, in front of; prep. + gen. (also adv.)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also adv. in tmesis with a verb of following: ’along with it’ (προτὶ … ἕποντο ’followed along with it’) · also + dat.: ’to, against’ (προτὶ γαίῃ ’against the ground’)
πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’) · also attributive, ’former’ (πρότερος πόσις ’former husband’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial · also + acc., ’against’ (πρὸς δαίμονα ’against a divinity’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτόλιος: πτόλις (epic for πόλις) — city; fem. gen. sg. (= Attic πόλεως)
πυλάων: πύλη — gate; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’) · also acc. pl. after ἐς: ’to the feet’ (ἐς πόδας ἄκρους ’to the tips of the feet’)
πόλεμος: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. nom. sg.
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πύματόν: πύματος — last, final; masc. acc. sg., predicative with με: ’last of all’ (acute added by the enclitic με)
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’ · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), attributive with a subject: ’the whole’ (πᾶν ξίφος ’the whole sword’)
πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, bane; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to the whole action · also neut. nom. sg., subject of λίποιτο: ’a woe (be left)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθέντες: ’woe’ (πῆμα τιθέντες ’inflicting woe’)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός, σή, σόν — your; neut. acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά), agreeing with ἔργα: ’your’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’) · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on your account’ (εἵνεκα σεῖο) · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’away from you’ · also gen. object of μεθήσω: ’let go of you’ (σεῖο μεθήσω ’I will not give you up’) · also gen. sg. of source after ἐξ: ’from you’ · also gen. object of χατίζω: ’need of you’
στέωμεν: ἵστημι — set; stand; aor. subj. 1 pl. intrans., epic short-vowel στέωμεν (= Attic στῶμεν): ’let us make a stand’
στήθεσφιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. in epic -φιν, a case ending serving as gen. or dat. (= Attic στήθους, στήθει); after ἀμφί: ’about the chest’ · also after διά: ’through the chest’ · also of separation, after ἐκ and ἀπό: ’out of the chest’, ’from the breast’
στήμεναι: ἵστημι (aor. root στη-) — stand; epic inf. in -μεναι (= Attic στῆναι)
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφισι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἔδονται: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀμφί: ’around you’ · also acc. sg., object of θῆκεν with a predicate acc.: ’you’ (σὲ λέοντα … θῆκεν ’made you a lion’)
σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄκοιτιν: ’your (wife)’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῷ: σός — your (sg.); masc. dat. sg., with πατρί · also with υἱέϊ: ’your (son)’ · also neut. dat. sg., with βέλεϊ: ’your (shaft)’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάλαντα: τάλαντον — scales, balance (also a weight, a talent); neut. acc. pl., the plural for a pair of scales · also neut. acc. pl., talents, a weight of gold: ’talents’
τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: τὸ τέταρτον ’the fourth time’ · also masc. acc. sg. with the article: τὸν τέταρτον ’the fourth (man)’
ταλαύρινον: ταλαύρινος — shield-enduring (τλῆναι + ῥινός; sense traditional), a standing epithet of Ares; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (or nom.), predicate of the hide shield with πολεμίζειν: ’shield-enduring’ (τό μοι ἔστι ταλαύρινον πολεμίζειν)
τανηλεγέος: τανηλεγής — meaning unknown (traditionally ’laying at full length’ or ’bringing long sorrow’), epithet of death; gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
ταχέεσσι: ταχύς — swift, fast; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic ταχέσι)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τείχεος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -εος (= Attic τείχους)
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἦ ἄρ: ’at all, in any way’ (ἦ ἄρ τι … ἄρειον ’was it in any way better?’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with χρεώ after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τί … χρεώ ’nor any need’) · τις, τι — neut. acc. sg., agreeing with εἶδος after οὔτε: ’any’ (οὔτέ τι εἶδος ’nor any looks’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοσσάκι: τοσσάκι(ς) — so often, that many times; adv., correlative of ὁσσάκι (= Attic τοσάκις)
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’ · also masc. nom. pl., in apposition, working as a relative: ’who’ (ἄνδρεσσι … τοὶ Ἰλίῳ ἐγγεγάασιν ’the men … who were born in Ilium’)
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’such a one’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’such (a thing)’, alone or correlative with οἷον (τοῖον … οἷον ’such … as’)
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’) · also fem. acc. sg. standing for a feminine thing: ’it’, in the correlative τὴν μέν … ’it, on the one hand’
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)

ἐπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; mid. ’obey’, + dat.; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’obeyed’
ἐπερχόμενον: ἐπέρχομαι — come on, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.

ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with πειράω, the opponent: ’(make trial) with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., the person deprived: ’(taken) from Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε): ’was dragging’ · also ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. acc. pl. ἕλκεα, elided (ἕλκε’ = ἕλκεα), uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκη): ’wounds’
ἕτερόν: ἕτερος — one of two, the other; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic γε: ’one or the other’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠθεῖ: ἠθεῖος — dear, honoured (exact sense not known); masc. voc. sg., elided (ἠθεῖ’ = ἠθεῖε), in address: ’my honoured one’
ἠλεύατο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= ἠλεύσατο, σ dropped): ’avoided’
ἡγήσατ: ἡγέομαι — lead, guide, + dat.; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἡγήσατ’ = ἡγήσατο)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’ · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative for a thing: ’it’ (of a spear)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or adverb of degree (ἤ περ ’than’) · also ἤ … ἦ, introducing a deliberative alternative: ’(shall I) … or …’ (ἤ μιν … θείω … ἦ … δαμάσσω) · also ἤ = ἦ with μοι in a self-addressed question: ’why indeed …?’ (τί ἤ μοι)
ἤμβροτες: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, miss the mark; aor. 2 sg., epic ἤμβροτον: ’you missed’
ἥρπασε: ἁρπάζω — snatch, seize; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’snatched’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; adv. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight on’ · also prep. + gen.: ’straight towards’
ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going, coming’
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
ἴδες: ὁράω — see; aor. 2 sg., from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδες, unaugmented): ’you saw’
ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came to, reached’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὁρμήσειε: ὁρμάω — set in motion, stir up (trans.); rush, charge (intrans.); aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause after ὁππότε: ’(when) he should rush’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause after ὁσσάκι: ’(as often as) he tried’
ὁσσάκι: ὁσσάκι(ς) — as often as, every time that; adv./conj. (= Attic ὁσάκις)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄρεσφι: ὄρος — mountain (epic οὖρος); neut. pl. in -φι(ν), ablatival/locatival (= Attic gen. ὀρῶν or dat. ὄρεσι): ’down the mountains’
ὄφρά: ὄφρα — so that, until, while; conj., epic (= Attic ἵνα, ἕως); with the subj.: ’so that’ (accent from the following enclitic) · also ὄφρα + indic., temporal: ’so long as’ (ὄφρά οἱ αἷμ’ … ἀνήνοθεν ’so long as the blood welled’) · also ὄφρα + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά σφιν … ῥύοιτο ’so that it might protect for them’)
ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπέρπτατο: ὑπερπέτομαι — fly over, fly beyond; aor. 3 sg. mid. (2nd aor. ὑπέρπτατο): ’flew over’
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὕστατον: ὕστατος — last; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τίνα, or neut. acc. sg. as adv.: ’last’
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
ῥέπε: ῥέπω — sink, incline downward (of a scale-pan); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρρεπε): ’sank’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
